approaches.name: land productivity map and land use decision tool
approaches.description: Finances a land productivity map and decision tool to guide agri-food land use decisions.
approaches.why_innovative: New product: geospatial land productivity map and decision tool - cue: 'remote sensing' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: It will finance: (i) a food system diagnostic, including agricultural and industrial censuses, and agri-food related surveus;35 (ii) a land productivity map and a land use decision tool;

extra_evidence.text: (iii) digitizing the MoA’s agricultural services, process and communication, including digitalization of extension services and support for the farmers registry and building the capacity of MoA on the use of remote sensing tools;

category.rationale: Technological: remote-sensing data tool is the core mechanism

sector.value: Agricultural Extension, Research, and Other Support Activities
sector.rationale: Land productivity mapping and decision tool supports research/extension advisory functions.
